description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the reliability, scalability and correctness of a transaction-processing platform and its supporting infrastructure. You will work across system design, deployment pipelines and monitoring, reasoning from first principles as usage grows many times over.
 What you'll do
 - Own the core transaction-processing systems end to end, including ledger accuracy and reconciliation.
 - Keep critical services reliable, correct and able to scale as usage grows significantly.
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and monitoring for production systems.
 - Design systems that combine many third-party vendors and understand how each component fits together.
 - Prioritize tests and engineering trade-offs sensibly in a fast-moving environment.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - At least 2 years of experience in distributed systems engineering.
 - Strong system design skills, with a deep and holistic view of complex multi-vendor architectures.
 - Experience with high data throughput workloads and some exposure to security.
 - A habit of reasoning from first principles rather than rigidly applying past solutions.
 - A strong sense of reliability and correctness under pressure.
 - High agency and autonomy, comfortable in a flat, hands-on team.
 - Comfortable using AI tools productively without depending on them.
 - No prior payments or fintech background is required.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with fast scaling at a growth-stage company.
 - Background on infrastructure teams at large cloud, trading or consumer technology companies.
 - Experience leading high-throughput distributed systems.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 150,000 to 210,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Medical, dental and vision coverage
 - Life insurance
 - Health FSA
 - Retirement plan
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, in office
 - Full-time
